what: Dated refresh of the JLC parts-API listing for the 30 A7 fitted identities at the owner-decided 2-module quantities. A point-in-time listing observation, not a quote, reservation, lead time or assembly acceptance. Supersedes 2026-11-12.json only as the latest dated observation; that file stays as history.
currency_note: JLC API price rows carry no currency field. Read as USD on the same basis as 2026-11-12.json (INFERRED).

parts_api.request: {"keyword": "<LCSC>", "currentPage": 1, "pageSize": 25, "searchSource": "search"}, anonymous; the row whose componentCode equals the LCSC code
parts_api.note: Per-line retrieved_at and raw_sha256 (bytes served). Sanitized copies are in the private repository at the commit below; this public file keeps hashes and locators only.

fee_page.quote: Components Per system Per system Feeder Loading $3.07 Extend $1.53 Basic/Extend

cost_rule: pieces_to_buy = max(pieces_required + loss_number, least_patch_number, min_purchase); line_cost = pieces_to_buy x the price tier for that quantity. Field meanings are our reading of an undocumented API.

field_meanings.note: stockCount read as JLC stock; canPresaleNumber as quantity available to pre-order; minPurchaseNum as minimum purchase; preMinPurchaseNum as pre-order minimum; leastPatchNumber and lossNumber as minimum patch and attrition; estimateDate is the only lead-time-like field and is null for every line.
